question: Who became the Chairperson of the National Statistical Commission (NSC) in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajeeva Laxman Karandikar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rajeeva Laxman Karandikar** was appointed as the Chairperson of the National Statistical Commission (NSC) in December 2022.
 
• He is a renowned statistician and was formerly the Director of Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI).
 
• Karandikar is well-known for his expertise in probability theory, statistical methods, and their applications in real-world problems.
 
• He has worked extensively in election forecasting, developing mathematical models to predict outcomes of elections based on data.
 
• As Chairperson of NSC, he oversees the development, implementation, and monitoring of statistical activities in India, ensuring data quality and transparency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pronab Sen**

 
 
• Pronab Sen is an Indian economist who served as the first Chief Statistician of India from 2007 to 2010.
 
• He played a key role in modernizing India’s statistical system and led the formulation of national accounts and price statistics.
 
• Sen was instrumental in the development of methodologies for economic surveys and improving data collection processes.
 
 
 
• **Bimal Jalan**
 
 
• Bimal Jalan is a prominent Indian economist and former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
 
• He has authored several books on economic policies and governance and played a significant role in India’s financial reforms during his tenure as RBI Governor.
 
• Jalan’s contributions are primarily in the field of monetary policy and macroeconomic stability.
 
 
 
• **Arvind Virmani**
 
 
• Arvind Virmani is an Indian economist who served as the Chief Economic Advisor to the Government of India from 2007 to 2009.
 
• He is known for his work on macroeconomic policy, international trade, and economic growth.
 
• Virmani has also represented India in several international organizations, including the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
 
 
 
• **National Statistical Commission (NSC)**
 
 
• NSC is an autonomous body established in 2006 to improve statistical systems and ensure the credibility of data in India.
 
• Its primary goal is to formulate policies and standards for statistical activities, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
 
• The Commission consists of a Chairperson, members, and a Secretary to assist in its operations.
 
• NSC plays a pivotal role in guiding the statistical ecosystem in India, enabling evidence-based policymaking.
